tracks.title: The Green Manalishi (With The Two Pronged Crown)

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1978 (UK).

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
Clear vinyl with a picture card insert containing track info and credits.
Original sound recording made by CBS Records

Track A is an edited/single version (the verse that begins, "I'm home once more, much better for" is omitted).
Track B1 recorded live at The Agora Ballroom, Cleveland, Ohio, May 9 1978

[nb: the stamped 'A' in the runout looks like 'Λ' - The 'A' represents the CBS pressing plant in Aston]
